title: Build the terminal viewer
lead: A terminal view of memory ownership and execution pointers, driven by a replay file, with step, play, pause and seek.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** live simulation; the web viewer.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Goal 6 and acceptance criterion C19. C25 recommends the terminal viewer first because debugging needs it.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - Terminal viewer package: a pure frame model plus a thin terminal renderer, and tests.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- The frame model at cycle N (cell ownership, execution pointers) equals the expected state for a fixture replay.
- Seeking to cycle N equals stepping N times.
- The step, play, pause and seek state machine.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- Standard library first: ANSI escape sequences for drawing.
- Raw keyboard input may need platform APIs or a dependency; that needs owner approval (C13).
- Gap: a default core of 8000 cells does not fit one screen. PROJECT.md does not say how to scale or page it; propose a layout.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- Manual: play the imp vs dwarf seed 1 replay; step, pause and seek work.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/<id>-tui` in `.worktrees/<id>`. One commit when the owner asks.
